args.body: Take TECHNICAL-TRANSLATION-REQUEST-TEST as a bounded independent market test. Catalogue comparison was STOP; do not reopen Shopify or generic CSV work. Seek an actual current paid request before producing anything. Existing private fulfillment can process pasted text, but collection is unavailable and no external account authority is implied. Reject unsupported rewards or prohibited AI use. Three candidates maximum; a precise stop is acceptable, and advertised payment is never verified funding.

description: The latest comparison establishes no paid advantage for the catalogue sample, so further Shopify development stops. Commercial feedback remains unclassified, not zero demand. Payment collection blocks paid acceptance but does not block a bounded test of a different, text-deliverable service using current public buyer requests. Funding and verified revenue remain zero.
